pcs.pc_description: utilize precision tools and digital measurement techniques to position and secure stones as per modern design specifications.
implement advanced stone-setting techniques, such as micro-pave and tension setting, to enhance brilliance and durability.
minimize pressure during setting to prevent microfractures or structural weaknesses in gemstones.
employ high-precision finishing tools to smooth edges, ensuring optimal comfort for the wearer.
integrate laser or ultrasonic cleaning methods to remove impurities and enhance the final finish.
adapt setting techniques to accommodate contemporary jewellery trends, such as minimalistic and invisible settings.
implement technology-assisted tracking systems to monitor and minimize metal and stone loss beyond permissible limits.
optimize resource utilization by incorporating eco-friendly practices and sustainable alternatives in metal settings.
utilize automated setting techniques, where applicable, to meet production targets without compromising quality.
synchronize workflow with digital project management tools to ensure timely delivery of set jewellery for further processing.
ensure precise levelling of stones using high-magnification optical tools for uniformity in design.
reinforce stone security with modern bonding techniques such as hybrid adhesive- assisted settings.
achieve a flawless setting finish by incorporating real-time quality checks using inspection tools.
